issues.description: Typo 'stlib' in user-facing deprecation docstring directive
issues.detail: The new `.. deprecated:: 4.3` block in falcon/testing/helpers.py reads 'Use the stlib's :func:`contextlib.redirect_stdout`'. 'stlib' should be 'stdlib' (or 'standard library'). This renders in published Sphinx docs and is visible to every user hitting the deprecation. Trivial fix; should land in this PR.

issues.description: News fragment classified as `.misc` rather than a deprecation type
issues.detail: docs/_newsfragments/2569.misc.rst documents a user-visible public API deprecation. Falcon's towncrier config typically has a dedicated deprecation fragment type so the entry surfaces in the Deprecations section of the changelog rather than Misc. Rename to `2569.deprecation.rst` (or whatever the project's config uses) after verifying against pyproject.toml.

issues.description: Verify decorator ordering preserves the contextmanager/generator protocol
issues.detail: `@falcon.util.deprecated` is applied above `@contextlib.contextmanager`, so deprecated wraps the generator function. If the deprecation wrapper doesn't preserve generator semantics, the context manager could break. The new test only covers the happy path; confirm `redirected(...)` still yields correctly and that the warning fires at the intended call site.

issues.description: Deprecation test does not assert exactly one warning or tighten the warning contract
issues.detail: test_deprecated_redirected wraps the entire `with` block in `pytest.warns`, which passes if any matching warning occurs. Capturing with `as record` and asserting `len(record) == 1` plus checking the warning fires at call time would tighten the deprecation contract and catch accidental double-firing.

issues.description: Import ordering of `contextlib` may violate project isort/ruff convention
issues.detail: In tests/test_cmd_inspect_app.py, `import contextlib` is inserted between `from argparse import Namespace` and `import io`. Falcon typically groups stdlib `import` statements separately from `from` imports alphabetically. Run `tox -e pep8` to confirm lint passes before merge.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus that this is a small, well-scoped, low-risk deprecation PR that correctly wires `@falcon.util.deprecated`, migrates internal call sites to stdlib, and adds a regression test. The unanimous blockers are cosmetic but user-visible: a 'stlib' typo in the rendered Sphinx docstring and a likely-miscategorized `.misc` newsfragment for what is a public API deprecation. A majority also wants confirmation that `@deprecated` stacked above `@contextlib.contextmanager` preserves generator semantics. Minor polish items include tightening the deprecation test and verifying import ordering against the project's lint config. Safe to merge after the typo, fragment type, and decorator-order verification.
